description_en: Encrypts plaintext by using a symmetric CMK
description_zh: 使用对称密钥将明文加密为密文
kebab_example: aliyun kms encrypt --key-id key-hzz630494463ejqjx0000 --plaintext SGVsbG8gd29y0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Encrypt

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.

When you access a key in another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`。
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The plaintext to be encrypted. The plaintext must be Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 待加密明文（必须经过Base64编码）
parameters.name: plaintext

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. If you specify this parameter, you must specify the same parameter when you call the Decrypt operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html
parameters.help_zh: key/value的JSON字符串。如果指定了该参数，则在调用Decrypt时需要提供同样的参数，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html。
parameters.name: encryption_context

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run feature.

true: enables the dry run feature.

false (default): disables the dry run feature.

The dry run feature is used to test API calls and verify the permissions on the resources that you have and the validity of the request parameters. You can view the check results in the response.

DryRunOperationError: The permissions and parameters are valid. If you do not specify the DryRun parameter, the request is successful.

ValidationError: The parameters in the request are invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。请根据返回消息查看验证结果。

DryRunOperationError：权限及参数配置正确。当不配置DryRun参数时，该请求将成功。
ValidationError：请求中配置的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

CiphertextBlob.description_en: The ciphertext of the data that is encrypted using the primary version of the specified key
CiphertextBlob.description_zh: 数据被指定密钥的主版本加密后的密文

KeyId.description_en: The ID of the key. If you use an alias or an ARN of the key in the request, the ID of the key is returned
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥ID。如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是密钥别名、密钥ARN，在响应中会返回密钥ID

KeyVersionId.description_en: The ID of the key version that is used to encrypt the plaintext. It is the primary version of the specified key
KeyVersionId.description_zh: 用于加密明文的密钥版本标志符。是指定密钥的主版本

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
